title: Any Advanced Wars/Final Fantasy Tactics fans?
author: cody-fifth-door

comments.author: cody-fifth-door
comments.body:
Goes without saying and I'm sure most of you are aware but Astra is amazing

Details  
Development time: \~1 day  
Tools used: Codex and Fifthdoor MCP  
Models used: Astra, Seedance 2.5, GPT Image 2.5, Elevenlabs for SFX  
Free assets: Kevin Macleod for background music  
  
Playable link here (with multiplayer!): [https://play.beta.fifthdoor.com/play/bannerfall](https://play.beta.fifthdoor.com/play/bannerfall)

replies.author: mccoypauley
replies.body: That intro video is wild, dude!

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body: Thanks! It was, believe it or not, also generated by Astra (prompting Seedance 2.5)

replies.author: mccoypauley
replies.body: I played a little and it was engaging, thanks for sharing

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body: Thanks for trying it out! I'm going to add a story mode and a faction editor then call it finished.

comments.author: ArachnidConstant8514
comments.body: I am working on something similar, but more in the visual style of Shining Force II for the Sega Genesis. I'm really struggling with getting ChatGPT to generate graphics assets. The pixel art's pixels aren't aligned with any grid, the animations are all over the place, and after two or three images it no longer can keep the character or the art style looking consistent. Do you have any tips?

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body:
Yeah there's a few tricks you can do tho

Some are in here for  instance: https://github.com/HappyOnigiri/PixelRefiner

Color quantization, pixel grid snapping, etc. 

At this point you can just ask Astra to build a pipeline to generate these and clean up though! Just give it a fal or openai key and let it loose.

replies.author: ArachnidConstant8514
replies.body: Thank you so much! That looks like a really useful tool.

comments.author: r0b0c0p87
comments.body: I'm building a 1v1 competitive online version of Final Fantasy Tactics as I write this! Like FFT meets Heroclix.

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body: Thanks!! Admittedly I have never played FFT myself😅

replies.author: r0b0c0p87
replies.body: Oh, it's a great game. Get a ps1 emulator and try it out. But Shining Force was a tile-based game for Genesis and when you attacked an enemy, it would go into a little cutscene similar to what your showing.
